How did relations with Russia develop under George H.W. Bush?

options.A: Cautious support for Gorbachev and Yeltsin
options.B: Unreserved support for Gorbachev and Yeltsin

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Cautious support for Gorbachev and Yeltsin

questions.stem_text:
In what way did the George W Bush administration change the direction of US foreign
policy?

options.A: It criticized international organizations, rather than trying to strengthen them
options.B: It expanded NATO to include former Soviet states
options.C: It focused on a more personal style of leadership
options.D: It increased international support for the United States

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It criticized international organizations, rather than trying to strengthen them

questions.stem_text:
Bureaucratic politics suggests we should be worried about which of the following with
regard to nuclear weapons?

options.A: Having the capability to deter the most powerful rival
options.B: Having the capability to deter smaller states
options.C: How nuclear attacks are identified and responded to; who controls the weapons
options.D: Bureaucratic politics provides no information about nuclear proliferation and use

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - How nuclear attacks are identified and responded to; who controls the weapons
